name: Satya Prakash Tiwari
tagline: Backend engineering · Distributed systems · Scalable SaaS · AI integrations
intro: I design and ship scalable backend systems, microservices and SaaS platforms. Over 8.5 years I've led teams of 15+ engineers, built platforms serving 10,000+ concurrent users, and integrated LLMs like Llama 3 and OpenAI into real products for clients across e-commerce, healthcare and logistics.
about: I'm a backend-focused full-stack engineer who enjoys turning messy business problems into reliable systems. My work spans B2B e-commerce, fantasy sports, healthcare compliance, recruitment, logistics and workflow automation.

Lately I've been focused on bringing AI into real products: integrating open-source and proprietary LLMs into CRMs and chatbots, and building my own developer tooling around AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code Router.
Outside client work I keep learning in public, through open-source projects and writing about system design and AI engineering.

items: LLMs (Llama 3, Phi-3, Gemma-2, Mistral, OpenAI API)

achievements: Led and mentored engineering teams of up to 15 developers, setting up agile processes and CI/CD practices.
Key architect of Shopdotapp, which raised venture capital funding after a smooth technical launch.
Delivered cross-border SaaS platforms for clients in India, the UK, the Middle East, Africa and Indonesia.
motto: backend systems, distributed systems and practical AI. always shipping.
bio: I'm a software engineer and technical lead with 8.5+ years of building backend-heavy, high-scale systems. Currently I'm a Senior Software Engineer at [Spark Eighteen](experience/#spark-eighteen), where I build microservices and data pipelines for enterprise SaaS, including a [pharma compliance platform](projects/#pharma-saas) and a [VC deal-sourcing CRM](projects/#vc-crm) with an AI chatbot.

Before that I was a Technical Lead at Ziqonfox Technologies, leading a team of 15+ engineers on a [B2B e-commerce engine](projects/#shopdotapp) that went on to raise venture funding, and a [fantasy sports platform](projects/#leagueswype) that handled 10,000+ concurrent users.

On the side, I build [Claude Code Router](projects/#claude-code-router), an open-source tool that routes every Claude Code prompt to the cheapest model that can handle it. It has 1,100+ downloads on PyPI and is also on npm.

I write about system design, databases and AI engineering on [my blog](https://devlore.hashnode.dev/) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/satya-prakash-be/). My work spans e-commerce, healthcare, logistics, recruitment and workflow automation, for clients in India, the UK, the Middle East, Africa and Indonesia.
